messages:
Ellen (CS): Notifying: several onboarding evals hit 401s when calling Dedicated pools (embed + generate). Affected customers: MetricWave, Formulate, Briefly. Opening triage.
Tom (CS): Ugh. Need two comms: short status for affected onboarding users, and a tailored note for two renewal-risk accounts (MetricWave & Briefly) offering credit + priority help.
Samir (Eng): Root cause: secret-rotation deployed a new KMS alias; a fraction of pool controllers didn't pick it up due to a rollout race. Ticket INF-8007.
SupportBot: Incident INF-8007 created by samir. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8007 status: investigating.
Tom (CS): Draft (general): "Hi 12we're investigating authentication failures (401) affecting Dedicated pools during onboarding. Engineers identified a secret-rotation mismatch and are deploying a fix now. We'll update in ~30-45 minutes and can provide an interim scoped key if needed. Apologies for the disruption."
Priya (AE): For renewal-risk add: "We recognize this impacts your evaluation. We can provision a temporary scoped key, rollback your previous key, and we'd like to offer one-month credit plus a direct engineering session to support your cutover."
Jon (Onboarding): Workaround CLI to share: `rwctl keys create --scope pool:<POOL_ID> --ttl 4h --label temp-onboard`. OpsDesk can DM keys to customer contacts.
OpsDesk: Confirmed  will generate ephemeral keys after CS shares pool IDs.
Ellen (CS): Pool IDs sent via DM. Posting comms and adding a one-question feedback line: "Did this materially affect your decision to proceed? Yes/No" for AE tracking.
Samir (Eng): Patch rollout started at 2026-03-24T08:10:00Z in batches; estimated recovery +30 minutes.
SupportBot: INF-8007 status: fix-deploying -> partial-recovery.
Samir (Eng): Patch finished at 2026-03-24T08:38:20Z. Post-deploy checks: pool-mw1 (MetricWave), pool-ff2 (Formulate), pool-br3 (Briefly) validated. Running 20m sampling.
SupportBot: INF-8007 resolved by samir. RCA summary: rollout race during secret-rotate left controllers with stale secret refs. Actions: add rollout gate to secret-rotate pipeline, enhance key-mismatch alerts, and add a CS incident template for auth failures.
Ellen (CS): I'll send RCA + apology + credit confirmation to MetricWave and Briefly and log follow-ups in INF-8007 and CS risk tracker. Uploading comms: https://drive.redwood.com/cs/onboarding/1919004321-onboard-auth-interruption.md
Priya (AE): I'll record the credit in finance tracker and follow up if legal changes required.
Tom (CS): Closing thread; reopen if customers escalate. :handshake:
